description: Returns products whose price has recently fallen in a market, best deals first, with the price now, the normal price it is compared with, the discount, how many shops sell it and the url of its Plendio page. Only genuine reductions are listed: the cut is recent, the price is the market's lowest, and the normal price comes from the product's own price history. Optionally narrowed to a category (slug) and a highest price in the market's currency. Up to 12 deals.

category.description: Category slug to narrow the deals to, e.g. computere (the slug of a category from the category list).

market.description: Market: dk, se, de or no. Default: the market of the site you connected to.

max_price.description: Highest price now, in the market's currency (major units, e.g. 500 means 500 kr.).

name: get_deals

converted.description: True when the shop prices in another currency and the amounts are converted.

discount_percent.description: How far under the normal price, in whole per cent.

lowest_ever.description: True when this is the lowest price on record.

lowest_in_days.description: The price is the lowest in this many days (of recorded history).

normal_price.description: The normal price the cut is measured against (the median of the product's lowest price before the cut).

price.description: Price now, in major units of currency, including VAT.

shop.description: The shop with the reduced price.

shops_selling.description: How many shops sell the product in the market.

url.description: The product's page on Plendio, listing all its offers.

total.description: How many deals match, over the 12 listed.

title: Get current deals
